reviewed_subjects.name: BERMLAUNCH_SUPPORTER_ENROLLMENT_R1_SEALED_20260807
reviewed_subjects.outcome: blocking finding raised, later closed and reproduced

governing_rule: Every fix ships with the test that would have caught it. All three findings so far were fixed correctly at the point of discovery and reappeared one layer over, because the evidence exercised the bypass rather than the enforcement.

fixes.title: Trust screen renders PASS with no evidence
fixes.defect: Four status fields default to their affirmative verification strings; the receipt booleans are then derived by comparing against those same constants, so missing evidence produces the string meaning 'verified' and the check compares it to itself.

reproduction.method: enrollmentSummary lifted verbatim, called with protocol = null
reproduction.note: The page cannot name the destination while certifying the wallet proof recovered to it.

required_change.checks: require positive evidence, e.g. protocol?.observation?.verified === true && status === "SIGNED_OBSERVATION_RECEIPT_VERIFIED"
required_change.ui: UNVERIFIED must render visibly differently — loud, as UNPROVEN_HISTORICAL is loud

acceptance: enrollmentSummary(null,null,null,null) yields all four statuses UNVERIFIED
derived receipt booleans are false and the verdict is not PASS
browser test renders with protocol = null and asserts no affirmative verification string appears in the DOM
UNVERIFIED styling asserted in a browser test, not reviewed by eye

fixes.title: Roster compiler accepts a caller-supplied observation as verified
fixes.defect: The left branch never calls verifyObservationReceipt — no signature check, no observer allowlist, observerPolicy never consulted.

reproduction.method: compileEnrollmentRoster with observerPolicy: null and a hand-written observation receiptId 'self-made'

expected_consequence.description: Removing the passthrough breaks the current e2e at the first production compile. This is not a regression — it is the proof that every existing test exercised the bypass.

fixes.related: packages/roster/verify_enrollment_evidence.mjs already enforces this correctly — mandatory policy, hash-bound to the constitution, real receipt verification. That enforcement sits beside the bypass rather than replacing it.
fixes.contradicted_claim: INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_R2.md:10 — 'C-02: CLOSED. Ordering now uses signed receipts.' True of the design, not of the enforcement.
acceptance: supporter_enrollment_r2_closure.mjs passes without pre-attaching trustedObservation to any record
every compileEnrollmentRoster call supplies real observationReceipts
negative test: receipt signed outside observerPolicy.observerPubkeys rejected AT COMPILE
negative test: observerPolicy null with receipts present fails closed
grep trustedObservation in packages/sdk/src shows no caller-supplied path

fixes.title: Make the fail-open pattern a build failure
fixes.principle: ?? and || supply a harmless default in ordinary code. In a verification path they manufacture proof, silently, at exactly the moment evidence is absent.

required_change.check: fail the build on ?? or || fallbacks assigned to identifiers matching /status|verified|proven|proof|finalizable|allowed/i
required_change.opt_out: // TRUST-DEFAULT-OK: <reason> — visible in review rather than invisible in syntax

fixes.precedent: scripts/check-supply-chain.mjs and scripts/check-caddyfile.mjs in the Berm repo
acceptance: the check fails on the pre-FIX-01 trustVerify.js, verified against that exact revision
the check passes after FIX-01 and FIX-02
runs in CI on every push, not only locally

fixes.title: bindLaunch is not permissionless despite the governing spec
fixes.defect: requires msg.sender == launchBinder while the governing spec describes bind_launch as permissionless verification
fixes.why_it_matters_beyond_code: 'permissionless verification' is a claim in the public story. Either make it permissionless or change the sentence; do not ship the gap.
acceptance: controller and non-controller binding paths tested, including negative cases for invalid Bags state
public copy matches whichever way it resolves

fixes.title: Manifest format defeats sha256sum -c
fixes.defect: FILE_MANIFEST_SHA256.txt uses three columns (sha256, bytes, path) with CRLF, so sha256sum -c reports 0 OK and all FAILED on an intact pack
fixes.required_change: one header line giving a verification command that works
acceptance: a reviewer can verify the pack with a command copied from its own header

size_estimate: FIX-01 and FIX-02 are a handful of lines each. The work is in the tests, which is where it should be.
